title: NFC West vs North
description: Your friends from the Midwest are always reminding you that the Seattle Seahawks won the NFC West Division with a losing record of 7-9 in 2011. At the time they were the only team to go to the NFL playoffs with a losing record (in a full season). To put an end to this nonsense you have decided to write a program to print the current NFC West and NFC North division standings.
outputDesc: Print the NFC West and NFC North division records as shown below. The character “-”, is a dash notan underscore.
